name: Comms Follow-up Assistant
description: Writes the next message on an existing thread (email or Slack), such as a renewal follow-up. It reads the thread in Gmail and Slack through the Nasiko MCP gateway, works out how many times you have already followed up without a reply, and drafts a short next message that changes approach and asks for one clear yes. It does not review or redline a contract, and it never mentions discounts or pricing. It saves a Gmail draft only after you approve the exact text, and it cannot send or post.

skills.name: Renewal follow-up
skills.description: Writes the next message on an existing thread with a customer contact, for example the unanswered renewal thread with Jordan Lee at Northwind. Reads Gmail and Slack, counts the unanswered follow-ups, and drafts one that asks for a yes on the proposed time or names the date you will assume. It does not review or redline a contract, and it does not send.
examples: Draft a follow-up to Jordan Lee at Northwind about the renewal and the MSA decisions. Check Gmail and Slack. Do not send it.
Jordan hasn't answered my two notes about Thursday's renewal call. Write the next email.
Save that follow-up as a Gmail draft in the Northwind renewal thread.
